user: I am still asking about that same non-delivery issue.
answer:
What I did:
- I reviewed Verta’s dispute rules for the goods_not_received reason.

What I found:
- Exact reason code: goods_not_received.
- A dispute must be raised against a single settled transaction and you must supply the transaction reference.
- Chargeback window for goods_not_received: 90 days from the transaction date.
- Evidence may be requested (order confirmation, delivery record, correspondence with the merchant). If evidence is requested, it must be supplied within 7 calendar days or the case may be declined.

What happens next:
- You previously asked me not to open a dispute, so I will not open one now.
- If you want me to proceed, I can first run a dispute eligibility check for the specific transaction and then open the dispute if eligible — tell me to proceed and provide the transaction reference when you’re ready. I can also escalate to a human reviewer if you prefer.

fragments.text:
Dispute handling process
## Evidence requirements
The customer may be asked for supporting evidence: an order confirmation, a
delivery record, correspondence with the merchant. Failure to supply requested
evidence within 7 calendar days results in the case being declined.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |
